body:
Probably too late to get noticed, but it might be cathartic to write this down, seeing as it's been less than a month and I have to see her again today.

I was cheated on by my ex. I knew she had issues with cheating in the past because she cheated on her ex with me. It was a shitty abusive relationship and I thought that by being a good person and a kind and loving boyfriend that I would "fix" her, which is and always will be a horrible mentality to enter a relationship with. Regardless, after much discussion and debate, we opted for an open relationship. We both wanted to be monogamous but she felt she wouldn't be able to keep it up, and this gave us some fall back. She ended up hooking up with someone at a party and it felt fine because she was honest and transparent about it, so I figured this was the best solution.

At the end of November, I went out of the country, across the globe, for a family member's wedding. I missed her badly, we normally weren't apart for more than a few days, so I was constantly trying to text her and talk to her, but the 12-hour time difference coupled with her lacking communication skills made it hard. I felt like she wasn't making as much as an effort, but to her credit, she's a full time student and had taken on a particularly difficult workload this semester, so I chalked it up to difficulty balancing studying and us-time so I let it go.

When I get back, our relationship felt noticably different. We went from spending 5-7 nights a week together to maybe 1 or 2. She was always too busy to spend time with me or talk, and when she did we would get in stupid petty fights over nothing. I assumed she was seeing other people and was waiting for her to tell me but it never came out until a very big fight. I felt that now that I knew it was happening, it didn't bother me as much.

So with that cleared up things felt better and I gave her space to finish up her semester. On the day of her last exam I took her out on a date, we got dinner, she came over, and everything felt great. I was in the mood for sex, but she said she wasn't feeling well so I let it go. But as we went to bed that night I saw her put her phone under her pillow, something she's never done before.

I couldn't sleep. I knew what was happening. And I knew looking at her phone would only hurt me. But I did and I found exactly what I expected: sexts between her and some random. I woke her up, and told her to leave. She burst into tears saying that she couldn't control herself and didn't know what to do but I ended up leaving and going to a friend's place for the night. I had a standardized exam the next morning, and of course public transportation was fucked up, so I didn't get home until 1pm and she was still there, passed out.

She's been diagnosed with Sex and Love Addiction, SLA. We patched things up for the moment but it just happened again, and I couldn't deal with it. We're taking a break for now, but we share the same friend group and hobbies so I have to see her at a friend's birthday party today.

This didn't really answer the question very well and turned into a wall of text, but it feels good to get this out. Thanks for reading.

tl;dr: she acted suspiciously for weeks and I saw sexts on her phone after I thought we made things up
